inspectedText: Tummers traces endorsement and later resistance to reattribution. Van Meegeren denied selling an authentic Old Master and claimed his own authorship, including other accepted paintings. Workshop evidence and an expert committee tested this. The text distinguishes his explanation of manufacture from laboratory findings about a modern binding medium and cites published1949 investigators and reproduced court statements. It supports the substantial payoff: the material used to fake age also proved modern origin. The thesis says he created a painting during the trial broadly; it does not authenticate a dramatic painting scene in a1947 courtroom.
